_instructions: REQUIRED: Configure the named organization, active pursuit type, capability map, qualification criteria, CRM database IDs, enrichment provider, and delivery destination for Capture Team (Chet, Kipp, Ben). 'qualification_profiles' covers business-development ICP, GovCon eligibility/capability alignment, grant eligibility/program alignment, and membership-development fit. Deadlines are a first-class signal throughout, not an afterthought. Notion and Google Drive fields are illustrative -- rename or restructure them to match the CRM and storage you actually use. Update whenever your capture process changes.

pursuit_types._instructions: Select one active pursuit type for an assignment. Add organization-specific types without changing the shared Find -> Qualify -> Research -> Capture workflow.

available.label: Membership development
available.candidate_noun: prospective member or membership progression opportunity

capability_map._instructions: One entry per placement-capable capability, for Chet's cluster discovery.

scanning._instructions: Sources Chet scans for new signals, and the minimum group size to qualify as a cluster.
scanning.gap_volume_threshold: [e.g. 3 -- minimum member count for a group to qualify]

qualification_profiles.label: [e.g. 'Government contractor, 10-200 employees' -- or a grant/funding profile like 'Community nonprofit, education programs', or a GovCon profile like 'Set-aside eligible, NAICS 541611']
qualification_profiles.size_range: [e.g. 10-200 employees or a revenue range -- leave blank if not applicable to this profile type]

qualification_criteria.requirement: [e.g. 'Eligible applicants must be located in Maryland']

deadline_tracking._instructions: Deadlines are a first-class qualification signal, not an afterthought -- Kipp surfaces deadline, days remaining, and timing risk whenever the candidate has one.

routing_flags._instructions: How Kipp's classified records get routed after intake.

notion._instructions: Named 'notion' for illustration only -- if you use a different CRM (Airtable, HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.), rename these keys and adapt the ID format to match.

enrichment._instructions: Kipp's contact/company enrichment provider and key.
enrichment.provider: [e.g. Hunter.io, Clearbit, Apollo, or whatever you use]
enrichment.api_key_env_var: [NAME OF YOUR ENV VAR -- never paste the key itself here]

delivery._instructions: Where Ben's finished briefs land. Named for Google Drive for illustration only -- use whatever storage location (OneDrive, SharePoint, etc.) and identifier your own tool needs.

brief_structure._instructions: Section headers for Ben's brief output. Customize to your delivery format.
